revised_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: TripPet iOS achievement medal raster art candidate, replacement for local candidate achievement_medal_steps_tier_010, later converted into a transparent 768x768 local candidate asset
Asset name: achievement_medal_steps_tier_010
Primary request: Regenerate tier 10, PURPLE rank, SECOND medal in the purple pair. Based on the Chinese title concept "11路公交车司机" (walking as the legendary foot-powered bus). The image itself must contain no text, no numbers, no labels; do not show the number eleven. This replacement must stay clearly purple after background removal.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #00ff00 chroma-key background for background removal. The background must be one uniform #00ff00 color with no shadows, gradients, texture, reflections, floor plane, transparency checkerboard, or lighting variation. Do not use #00ff00 anywhere in the subject.
Subject: exactly one centered circular collectible medal. Inside the circle is the same funny anthropomorphic foot mascot style: soft foot-shaped body, five toes on top like a goofy crown/hair tuft, tiny cartoon arms and tiny legs, expressive face. Tier 10 pose: the foot mascot pretends to be a tiny bus driver, wearing a small plain driver cap with no badge or text, holding a simple steering wheel prop while running on its own feet, with dotted route-stop beads around it. No letters, no digits, no transit logos.
Medal border: PURPLE rank, SECOND purple medal. Use a refined violet and amethyst enamel circular border with silver trim, purple gems, elegant top crest, and clearly visible symmetrical purple side wings / feather-like purple-silver wings extending outward from the circle. This must be more ornate than tier 9 and obviously the upgraded second medal of the purple pair. No blue, orange, or gold rank color dominance.
Style/medium: same premium mobile game collectible style as the new TripPet travel medals and previous anthropomorphic foot candidates: polished 3D-like enamel and metal, glossy highlights, cute humorous center character, crisp small-UI readability, not watercolor paper.
Composition/framing: exactly one centered medal, full object visible, generous padding, square composition, central foot mascot fully inside circular core, side wings visible but inside safe margins.
Lighting/mood: bright soft studio highlights, silly and triumphant.
Color palette: clearly violet and amethyst purple border, silver trim, warm cream foot mascot, soft blush, muted lavender route beads; avoid #00ff00 anywhere in subject.
Text: none.
Constraints: include purple side wings, include feather-like purple-silver wings, no letters, no numbers, no Chinese, no labels, no logos, no watermark, no cast shadow, no contact shadow, no reflection, do not create multiple medals, no shield shape, no dark UI card.
rank_color_rule: 007-008 blue, 009-010 purple, 011-012 orange, 013-014 gold; second medal of each color pair has wings
wing_rule: second medal in color pair has wings
transparent_background_method: built-in image_gen on #00ff00 chroma key for purple candidate, remove_chroma_key.py auto-key soft matte despill, resize to 768x768
